title: bada-compatible v2: an event
description: What a harness passes to P_send (the standard, §5). An engine ignores fields it doesn't know in an event whose type it knows.

oneOf.title: key
oneOf.description: One key press the harness wants read.

key.description: A W3C KeyboardEvent.code: the key's physical position. Any string is accepted; an unknown code is a key the engine doesn't handle.

repeat.description: The press is a repeat of a held key. Missing: false.

oneOf.title: action
oneOf.description: A request by name: one of the engine's actions (menu.next, menu.prev, fix, width.full, width.half) or a layout's (<layout id>.<action id>).

oneOf.title: select
oneOf.description: The mode and the henkan profile of this text field. Commits what is staged if either changes.

profile.description: A profile id of the settings; required in henkan. In muhenkan it is kept and echoed, and may be null.

oneOf.title: pick
oneOf.description: Picks a row of the menu, by pointer or touch.

row.description: Index into the last reply's menu.rows.

oneOf.title: text
oneOf.description: The harness's answer to a reply's ask, once.

selection.description: The selected text; "" if nothing is selected or something is marked.

before.description: The text before the caret, at most as many characters as asked.

after.description: The text after the caret, at most as many characters as asked.

oneOf.title: reset
oneOf.description: Drops what is staged; commits nothing.

oneOf.title: state
oneOf.description: Changes nothing: the reply is the last one again.

oneOf.title: settings
oneOf.description: A session event: replaces (set) or merges (patch, a JSON merge patch) the engine's settings. With neither, re-reads them.

set.description: The whole engine part of a settings file.

patch.description: A JSON merge patch (RFC 7396) on the engine part.

oneOf.title: layout
oneOf.description: A session event: adds or replaces a custom layout (value), removes one (id, with value null), or with neither lists the session's layouts.

oneOf.title: dictionary
oneOf.description: A session event: sets the session's user dictionary (value), clears it (null), or with no value re-reads its summary.

value.description: The dictionary object (the dictionary contract), or null.
